snippet: Although coiled-coil domain containing 69 (CCDC69) has been implicated in tumor biology, its role in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) and immune regulation remains unclear. snippet: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is the most common histological subtype of lung cancer, with a dismal prognosis partly attributed to immune evasion mediated by T cell dysfunction within the tumor microenvironment.
